'''Jono Monroe Uterus' Scum For Life''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Jono Monroe]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-12742">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/12742 Uterus' Scum For Life], DeckTech (Jono "comp-uterus" Monroe, 7 January 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/12742/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/12742/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018075330/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/12742/ Wayback Machine].</ref>
